# Hand-written effects (NOT regenerated by scripts/advance_parser.py).

# Registers this mod's settings with the Community Mod Framework's in-game
# menu (Community Mod Menu). Called from cmf_on_mod_registration.
# Setting values are read back with "global_variable_map(cmm|flag:<mod>__<id>)".
rl_cmf_register = {
    # Roll sources
    cmm_register_global_bool_setting = {
        mod_id = europa_survivors
        setting_id = roll_on_research
        tab_id = general
        group_id = sources
        default_value = 1
    }
    cmm_register_global_bool_setting = {
        mod_id = europa_survivors
        setting_id = roll_on_battle
        tab_id = general
        group_id = sources
        default_value = 1
    }
    cmm_register_global_bool_setting = {
        mod_id = europa_survivors
        setting_id = roll_on_new_age
        tab_id = general
        group_id = sources
        default_value = 1
    }
    # Gameplay
    cmm_register_global_bool_setting = {
        mod_id = europa_survivors
        setting_id = enable_reroll
        tab_id = general
        group_id = gameplay
        default_value = 1
    }
    cmm_register_global_bool_setting = {
        mod_id = europa_survivors
        setting_id = enable_cursed
        tab_id = general
        group_id = gameplay
        default_value = 1
    }
    cmm_register_global_bool_setting = {
        mod_id = europa_survivors
        setting_id = enable_sets
        tab_id = general
        group_id = gameplay
        default_value = 1
    }
    cmm_register_global_bool_setting = {
        mod_id = europa_survivors
        setting_id = enable_threat
        tab_id = general
        group_id = gameplay
        default_value = 1
    }
    cmm_register_global_bool_setting = {
        mod_id = europa_survivors
        setting_id = enable_banish
        tab_id = general
        group_id = gameplay
        default_value = 1
    }
    cmm_register_global_bool_setting = {
        mod_id = europa_survivors
        setting_id = enable_artifacts
        tab_id = general
        group_id = gameplay
        default_value = 1
    }
    # Action-bar button that opens the roguelite status window.
    cmf_add_action_bar_element = {
        element = rl_status_button
    }
    # Marks that registration has run, so rl_enabled can tell "setting is off"
    # apart from "settings not registered yet". CMF fires the registration hook
    # from its YEARLY human-country pulse, so before the first pulse (new game,
    # or after loading a save) the settings map reads 0 for everything -- which
    # would silently disable the whole mod. See rl_enabled.
    set_global_variable = rl_settings_ready
}

# rl_ensure_vars: give this country any of our variables it is missing.
#
# Runs every month, but the body is guarded by a version sentinel so it only
# does work once per country per mod version. Bump the sentinel name (rl_vars_vN)
# whenever new variables are added, so existing saves pick them up -- otherwise
# comparisons and change_variable against an unset variable silently no-op.
rl_ensure_vars = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = rl_vars_v4 } }

        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = rl_event_1 } } set_variable = { name = rl_event_1 value = -1 } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = rl_event_2 } } set_variable = { name = rl_event_2 value = -1 } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = rl_event_3 } } set_variable = { name = rl_event_3 value = -1 } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = rl_rarity } } set_variable = { name = rl_rarity value = 1 } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = rl_cursed } } set_variable = { name = rl_cursed value = 0 } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = rl_curse } } set_variable = { name = rl_curse value = 1 } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = rl_reroll_tokens } } set_variable = { name = rl_reroll_tokens value = 2 } }

        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = rl_tag_military } } set_variable = { name = rl_tag_military value = 0 } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = rl_tag_naval } } set_variable = { name = rl_tag_naval value = 0 } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = rl_tag_economic } } set_variable = { name = rl_tag_economic value = 0 } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = rl_tag_admin } } set_variable = { name = rl_tag_admin value = 0 } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = rl_threat } } set_variable = { name = rl_threat value = 0 } }

        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = rl_uniq_1 } } set_variable = { name = rl_uniq_1 value = -1 } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = rl_uniq_2 } } set_variable = { name = rl_uniq_2 value = -1 } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = rl_uniq_3 } } set_variable = { name = rl_uniq_3 value = -1 } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = rl_uniq_taken } } set_variable = { name = rl_uniq_taken value = 0 } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = rl_artifact_roll } } set_variable = { name = rl_artifact_roll value = 0 } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = rl_force_legendary } } set_variable = { name = rl_force_legendary value = 0 } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = rl_pacts_made } } set_variable = { name = rl_pacts_made value = 0 } }

        # Curse stack counters (see rl_apply_curse). A save from before curses
        # stacked may already carry a curse at size 1, so start that one at 2.
        rl_init_curse_stacks = { n = 1 }
        rl_init_curse_stacks = { n = 2 }
        rl_init_curse_stacks = { n = 3 }
        rl_init_curse_stacks = { n = 4 }
        rl_init_curse_stacks = { n = 5 }

        set_variable = rl_vars_v4
    }
}

rl_init_curse_stacks = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = rl_curse_$n$_next } }
        if = {
            limit = { has_country_modifier = modifier_rl_curse_$n$ }
            set_variable = { name = rl_curse_$n$_next value = 2 }
        }
        else = {
            set_variable = { name = rl_curse_$n$_next value = 1 }
        }
    }
}

# rl_pick_three: fill rl_event_1/2/3 with three DISTINCT not-yet-owned advance
# indices. rl_rand_se (generated) picks a random index into rl_event_$v$.
rl_pick_three = {
    rl_rand_se = { v = 1 }

    set_variable = { name = rl_event_2 value = -1 }
    set_variable = { name = rl_event_3 value = -1 }

    while = {
        limit = {
            OR = {
                var:rl_event_2 = var:rl_event_1
                var:rl_event_2 = -1
            }
        }
        rl_rand_se = { v = 2 }
    }

    while = {
        limit = {
            OR = {
                var:rl_event_3 = var:rl_event_1
                var:rl_event_3 = var:rl_event_2
                var:rl_event_3 = -1
            }
        }
        rl_rand_se = { v = 3 }
    }
}

# rl_roll_rarity: set rl_rarity to 1 (common), 2 (rare) or 3 (legendary).
# A token-shop purchase can force the next roll to be legendary.
rl_roll_rarity = {
    if = {
        limit = { var:rl_force_legendary = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = rl_rarity value = 3 }
        set_variable = { name = rl_force_legendary value = 0 }
    }
    else = {
        if = {
            # Boon: Fortune's Favourite -- better odds.
            limit = { var:rl_boon ?= 6 }
            random_list = {
                50 = { set_variable = { name = rl_rarity value = 1 } }
                32 = { set_variable = { name = rl_rarity value = 2 } }
                18 = { set_variable = { name = rl_rarity value = 3 } }
            }
        }
        else = {
            random_list = {
                65 = { set_variable = { name = rl_rarity value = 1 } }
                27 = { set_variable = { name = rl_rarity value = 2 } }
                8  = { set_variable = { name = rl_rarity value = 3 } }
            }
        }
    }
    # Boon: Cursed Bloodline -- never Common.
    if = {
        limit = { var:rl_boon ?= 5  var:rl_rarity = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = rl_rarity value = 2 }
    }
    # Boon: Quiet Rise -- never Legendary, even when guaranteed.
    if = {
        limit = { var:rl_boon ?= 7  var:rl_rarity = 3 }
        set_variable = { name = rl_rarity value = 2 }
    }
}

# rl_roll_curse: high risk / high reward. Rare and legendary rolls have a chance
# to be cursed (applies a random drawback when any option is taken). Common rolls
# are never cursed. Disabled by the enable_cursed setting.
rl_roll_curse = {
    set_variable = { name = rl_cursed value = 0 }
    if = {
        limit = {
            rl_enabled_enable_cursed = yes
        }
        if = {
            # Boon: Cursed Bloodline -- every roll is cursed.
            limit = { var:rl_boon ?= 5 }
            rl_set_curse = yes
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:rl_rarity = 3 }
            random_list = {
                50 = { rl_set_curse = yes }
                50 = { }
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:rl_rarity = 2 }
            random_list = {
                20 = { rl_set_curse = yes }
                80 = { }
            }
        }
    }
}

rl_set_curse = {
    set_variable = { name = rl_cursed value = 1 }
    random_list = {
        1 = { set_variable = { name = rl_curse value = 1 } }
        1 = { set_variable = { name = rl_curse value = 2 } }
        1 = { set_variable = { name = rl_curse value = 3 } }
        1 = { set_variable = { name = rl_curse value = 4 } }
        1 = { set_variable = { name = rl_curse value = 5 } }
    }
}

# rl_apply_curse: if the current roll is cursed, apply its drawback. Called by
# every option's effect so any choice carries the curse.
#
# Curses STACK: taking the same curse again deepens it. A plain
# add_country_modifier on a modifier the country already has only refreshes it,
# so a second copy of a curse used to do nothing -- which let players spam the
# dark pact for free once they held all five curses. Instead each curse keeps
# rl_curse_<n>_next (its size after the next application) and is re-applied at
# that size with mode = replace, the same pattern rl_apply_threat uses.
rl_apply_curse = {
    if = {
        limit = { var:rl_cursed = 1 }
        if = { limit = { var:rl_curse = 1 } rl_stack_curse = { n = 1 } }
        else_if = { limit = { var:rl_curse = 2 } rl_stack_curse = { n = 2 } }
        else_if = { limit = { var:rl_curse = 3 } rl_stack_curse = { n = 3 } }
        else_if = { limit = { var:rl_curse = 4 } rl_stack_curse = { n = 4 } }
        else = { rl_stack_curse = { n = 5 } }
    }
}

# The size is read BEFORE the counter moves: options also run rl_apply_curse
# inside show_as_tooltip, where effects are only previewed, so the preview shows
# the size the curse will actually have after it is taken.
rl_stack_curse = {
    # rl_ensure_vars only runs on the monthly pulse, so after loading an older
    # save the counter may not exist yet; an unset size would read 0.
    hidden_effect = { rl_init_curse_stacks = { n = $n$ } }
    add_country_modifier = {
        modifier = modifier_rl_curse_$n$
        years = -1
        size = var:rl_curse_$n$_next
        mode = replace
    }
    hidden_effect = {
        change_variable = { name = rl_curse_$n$_next add = 1 }
    }
}

# --- Unique artifacts -------------------------------------------------------
# There are 12 artifacts (modifier_rl_uniq_1..12). Each can be taken once per
# run; var_uniq_<n> marks one as owned and excludes it from future draws.

# rl_uniq_rand: pick a random not-yet-owned artifact index into rl_uniq_$v$.
rl_uniq_rand = {
    random_list = {
        1 = { trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = var_uniq_1 } }  set_variable = { name = rl_uniq_$v$ value = 1 } }
        1 = { trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = var_uniq_2 } }  set_variable = { name = rl_uniq_$v$ value = 2 } }
        1 = { trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = var_uniq_3 } }  set_variable = { name = rl_uniq_$v$ value = 3 } }
        1 = { trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = var_uniq_4 } }  set_variable = { name = rl_uniq_$v$ value = 4 } }
        1 = { trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = var_uniq_5 } }  set_variable = { name = rl_uniq_$v$ value = 5 } }
        1 = { trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = var_uniq_6 } }  set_variable = { name = rl_uniq_$v$ value = 6 } }
        1 = { trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = var_uniq_7 } }  set_variable = { name = rl_uniq_$v$ value = 7 } }
        1 = { trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = var_uniq_8 } }  set_variable = { name = rl_uniq_$v$ value = 8 } }
        1 = { trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = var_uniq_9 } }  set_variable = { name = rl_uniq_$v$ value = 9 } }
        1 = { trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = var_uniq_10 } } set_variable = { name = rl_uniq_$v$ value = 10 } }
        1 = { trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = var_uniq_11 } } set_variable = { name = rl_uniq_$v$ value = 11 } }
        1 = { trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = var_uniq_12 } } set_variable = { name = rl_uniq_$v$ value = 12 } }
    }
}

# rl_pick_three_uniques: up to three DISTINCT unowned artifacts into
# rl_uniq_1/2/3. When fewer than three remain, the spare slots stay -1, which
# matches no option in rl_status.4, so only the remaining artifacts are offered.
# Each distinctness loop only runs when enough artifacts remain for it to
# terminate. Needs at least one unowned (see rl_try_artifact_roll).
rl_pick_three_uniques = {
    rl_uniq_rand = { v = 1 }

    set_variable = { name = rl_uniq_2 value = -1 }
    set_variable = { name = rl_uniq_3 value = -1 }

    if = {
        limit = { var:rl_uniq_taken <= 10 }
        while = {
            limit = {
                OR = {
                    var:rl_uniq_2 = var:rl_uniq_1
                    var:rl_uniq_2 = -1
                }
            }
            rl_uniq_rand = { v = 2 }
        }
    }

    if = {
        limit = { var:rl_uniq_taken <= 9 }
        while = {
            limit = {
                OR = {
                    var:rl_uniq_3 = var:rl_uniq_1
                    var:rl_uniq_3 = var:rl_uniq_2
                    var:rl_uniq_3 = -1
                }
            }
            rl_uniq_rand = { v = 3 }
        }
    }
}

# rl_take_unique: claim artifact $n$ -- grant its modifier, mark it owned, count
# it, apply escalating threat like any other upgrade, and check the collection
# capstones.
rl_take_unique = {
    add_country_modifier = { modifier = modifier_rl_uniq_$n$ years = -1 }
    set_variable = var_uniq_$n$
    change_variable = { name = rl_uniq_taken add = 1 }
    rl_apply_threat = yes
    rl_check_artifact_capstones = yes
}

# rl_check_artifact_capstones: escalating rewards for collecting artifacts.
# Granted once each, at 3 / 6 / 9 / 12 (all) artifacts.
rl_check_artifact_capstones = {
    if = {
        limit = { var:rl_uniq_taken >= 3  NOT = { has_variable = rl_artifact_set_1 } }
        set_variable = rl_artifact_set_1
        add_country_modifier = { modifier = modifier_rl_artifact_set_1 years = -1 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { var:rl_uniq_taken >= 6  NOT = { has_variable = rl_artifact_set_2 } }
        set_variable = rl_artifact_set_2
        add_country_modifier = { modifier = modifier_rl_artifact_set_2 years = -1 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { var:rl_uniq_taken >= 9  NOT = { has_variable = rl_artifact_set_3 } }
        set_variable = rl_artifact_set_3
        add_country_modifier = { modifier = modifier_rl_artifact_set_3 years = -1 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { var:rl_uniq_taken >= 12  NOT = { has_variable = rl_artifact_set_4 } }
        set_variable = rl_artifact_set_4
        add_country_modifier = { modifier = modifier_rl_artifact_set_4 years = -1 }
    }
}

# rl_dark_pact: the devil's bargain. Accept a random permanent curse right now,
# and in exchange immediately draw a guaranteed Legendary selection (which may
# also be an artifact roll). Repeatable -- but each pact stacks another curse,
# so it is self-limiting.
rl_dark_pact = {
    rl_set_curse = yes      # choose a curse (sets rl_cursed = 1, picks rl_curse)
    rl_apply_curse = yes    # inflict it now
    # Clear the flag so this curse is not applied a second time by the options
    # of the roll we are about to open.
    set_variable = { name = rl_cursed value = 0 }
    change_variable = { name = rl_pacts_made add = 1 }
    set_variable = { name = rl_force_legendary value = 1 }
    rl_do_roll = yes
}

# rl_try_artifact_roll: a legendary roll has a 50% chance to become an artifact
# roll instead of a scaled advance roll -- but only while at least 3 artifacts
# remains unowned (rl_uniq_taken <= 11) and artifacts are enabled.
rl_try_artifact_roll = {
    set_variable = { name = rl_artifact_roll value = 0 }
    if = {
        limit = {
            rl_enabled_enable_artifacts = yes
            var:rl_uniq_taken <= 11
        }
        random_list = {
            50 = { set_variable = { name = rl_artifact_roll value = 1 } }
            50 = { }
        }
    }
}

# rl_do_roll: standard roll (random rarity). Used by research.
rl_do_roll = {
    rl_roll_rarity = yes
    if = {
        limit = { var:rl_rarity = 3 }
        rl_try_artifact_roll = yes
    }
    else = {
        set_variable = { name = rl_artifact_roll value = 0 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { var:rl_artifact_roll = 1 }
        rl_pick_three_uniques = yes
        trigger_event_non_silently = { id = rl_status.4 }
    }
    else = {
        rl_roll_curse = yes
        rl_pick_three = yes
        trigger_event_non_silently = { id = rl_events.1 }
    }
}

# rl_do_roll_legendary: guaranteed legendary roll. Used by new-age milestones.
rl_do_roll_legendary = {
    set_variable = { name = rl_rarity value = 3 }
    rl_try_artifact_roll = yes
    if = {
        limit = { var:rl_artifact_roll = 1 }
        rl_pick_three_uniques = yes
        trigger_event_non_silently = { id = rl_status.4 }
    }
    else = {
        rl_roll_curse = yes
        rl_pick_three = yes
        trigger_event_non_silently = { id = rl_events.1 }
    }
}

# --- Token shop -------------------------------------------------------------

# rl_cleanse_curses: remove every curse modifier currently on the country.
# Costs var:rl_cleanse_cost tokens, set when the token shop opens (rl_status.5).
rl_cleanse_curses = {
    set_variable = {
        name = rl_reroll_tokens
        value = {
            value = var:rl_reroll_tokens
            subtract = var:rl_cleanse_cost
        }
    }
    remove_country_modifier = modifier_rl_curse_1
    remove_country_modifier = modifier_rl_curse_2
    remove_country_modifier = modifier_rl_curse_3
    remove_country_modifier = modifier_rl_curse_4
    remove_country_modifier = modifier_rl_curse_5
    # Reset the stacks so the next curse starts over at size 1.
    set_variable = { name = rl_curse_1_next value = 1 }
    set_variable = { name = rl_curse_2_next value = 1 }
    set_variable = { name = rl_curse_3_next value = 1 }
    set_variable = { name = rl_curse_4_next value = 1 }
    set_variable = { name = rl_curse_5_next value = 1 }
}

# rl_buy_legendary: the next roll is guaranteed legendary.
rl_buy_legendary = {
    change_variable = { name = rl_reroll_tokens add = -5 }
    set_variable = { name = rl_force_legendary value = 1 }
}

# rl_buy_extra_roll: draw an upgrade selection right now.
rl_buy_extra_roll = {
    change_variable = { name = rl_reroll_tokens add = -4 }
    rl_do_roll = yes
}

# rl_do_reroll: replace the three offered options (keeps the current rarity) and
# re-open the event. Spends one banked reroll token.
rl_do_reroll = {
    change_variable = { name = rl_reroll_tokens add = -1 }
    rl_pick_three = yes
    trigger_event_non_silently = { id = rl_events.1 }
}

# NOTE: banishing is emitted inline by the generator (set var_<name>, spend a
# token, then fire the hidden redraw event rl_status.2). It deliberately does NOT
# use a parameterised scripted effect here: a parameterised effect is expanded at
# every call site, so inlining rl_pick_three's 2566-entry random_list into ~2566
# banish options made hovering them lag the game.

# rl_grant_reroll_token: award one banked reroll token (capped), the reward for
# winning a great battle. Rerolls are spent on future selection events.
rl_grant_reroll_token = {
    # Boon: Fortune's Favourite -- no tokens, ever.
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:rl_boon ?= 6 } }
        if = {
            limit = { has_variable = rl_reroll_tokens }
            if = {
                limit = { var:rl_reroll_tokens < 10 }
                change_variable = { name = rl_reroll_tokens add = 1 }
            }
        }
        else = {
            set_variable = { name = rl_reroll_tokens value = 1 }
        }
    }
}

# rl_apply_threat: getting stronger makes the world wary. Each upgrade taken
# raises rl_threat; the notoriety modifier is refreshed at a size that grows in
# tiers (every few upgrades). Gated by the enable_threat setting.
rl_apply_threat = {
    change_variable = { name = rl_threat add = 1 }
    if = {
        limit = {
            rl_enabled_enable_threat = yes
            # Boon: Quiet Rise -- upgrades are still counted, never feared.
            NOT = { var:rl_boon ?= 7 }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { var:rl_threat >= 55 }
            add_country_modifier = { modifier = modifier_rl_notoriety years = -1 size = 6 mode = replace }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:rl_threat >= 35 }
            add_country_modifier = { modifier = modifier_rl_notoriety years = -1 size = 4 mode = replace }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:rl_threat >= 20 }
            add_country_modifier = { modifier = modifier_rl_notoriety years = -1 size = 3 mode = replace }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:rl_threat >= 10 }
            add_country_modifier = { modifier = modifier_rl_notoriety years = -1 size = 2 mode = replace }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:rl_threat >= 5 }
            add_country_modifier = { modifier = modifier_rl_notoriety years = -1 size = 1 mode = replace }
        }
    }
}

# rl_take_<tag>: called when an upgrade of that theme is taken. Counts the pick
# toward its synergy set (granting escalating set bonuses at 4 / 8 / 12 / 16) and
# applies escalating threat. Set bonuses are gated by the enable_sets setting.
rl_take_military = {
    change_variable = { name = rl_tag_military add = 1 }
    if = { limit = { var:rl_boon ?= 1 } change_variable = { name = rl_tag_military add = 1 } }
    rl_apply_threat = yes
    if = {
        limit = { rl_enabled_enable_sets = yes }
        if = { limit = { var:rl_tag_military >= 4  NOT = { has_variable = rl_set_military_1 } }  set_variable = rl_set_military_1  add_country_modifier = { modifier = modifier_rl_set_military_1 years = -1 } }
        if = { limit = { var:rl_tag_military >= 8  NOT = { has_variable = rl_set_military_2 } }  set_variable = rl_set_military_2  add_country_modifier = { modifier = modifier_rl_set_military_2 years = -1 } }
        if = { limit = { var:rl_tag_military >= 12 NOT = { has_variable = rl_set_military_3 } }  set_variable = rl_set_military_3  add_country_modifier = { modifier = modifier_rl_set_military_3 years = -1 } }
        if = { limit = { var:rl_tag_military >= 16 NOT = { has_variable = rl_set_military_4 } }  set_variable = rl_set_military_4  add_country_modifier = { modifier = modifier_rl_set_military_4 years = -1 } }
    }
}

rl_take_naval = {
    change_variable = { name = rl_tag_naval add = 1 }
    if = { limit = { var:rl_boon ?= 2 } change_variable = { name = rl_tag_naval add = 1 } }
    rl_apply_threat = yes
    if = {
        limit = { rl_enabled_enable_sets = yes }
        if = { limit = { var:rl_tag_naval >= 4  NOT = { has_variable = rl_set_naval_1 } }  set_variable = rl_set_naval_1  add_country_modifier = { modifier = modifier_rl_set_naval_1 years = -1 } }
        if = { limit = { var:rl_tag_naval >= 8  NOT = { has_variable = rl_set_naval_2 } }  set_variable = rl_set_naval_2  add_country_modifier = { modifier = modifier_rl_set_naval_2 years = -1 } }
        if = { limit = { var:rl_tag_naval >= 12 NOT = { has_variable = rl_set_naval_3 } }  set_variable = rl_set_naval_3  add_country_modifier = { modifier = modifier_rl_set_naval_3 years = -1 } }
        if = { limit = { var:rl_tag_naval >= 16 NOT = { has_variable = rl_set_naval_4 } }  set_variable = rl_set_naval_4  add_country_modifier = { modifier = modifier_rl_set_naval_4 years = -1 } }
    }
}

rl_take_economic = {

        if = { limit = { var:rl_tag_economic >= 12 NOT = { has_variable = rl_set_economic_3 } }  set_variable = rl_set_economic_3  add_country_modifier = { modifier = modifier_rl_set_economic_3 years = -1 } }
        if = { limit = { var:rl_tag_economic >= 16 NOT = { has_variable = rl_set_economic_4 } }  set_variable = rl_set_economic_4  add_country_modifier = { modifier = modifier_rl_set_economic_4 years = -1 } }

    }

# rl_grant_mod: apply a stripped-advance modifier, scaled by the current rarity
# via the modifier's size (2x rare, 5x legendary). $m$ is the modifier name.
rl_grant_mod = {
    if = {
        limit = { var:rl_rarity = 3 }
        add_country_modifier = { modifier = $m$ years = -1 size = 5 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { var:rl_rarity = 2 }
        add_country_modifier = { modifier = $m$ years = -1 size = 2 }
    }
    else = {
        add_country_modifier = { modifier = $m$ years = -1 size = 1 }
    }
}

# rl_init_country: one-time setup for a country the mod has not seen yet.
# Researches the dummy parent (so the per-unlock dummy advances can be granted)
# and snapshots the current advance count as the research-roll baseline.
# Callers check NOT has_variable num_advances first.
rl_init_country = {
    research_advance = advance_type:dummy_parent_advance
    set_variable = {
        name = num_advances
        value = { add = modifier:rl_roll_mtd }
    }
}

# --- Chaos Draft (fun option) -----------------------------------------------

# rl_fun_mass_roll: claim up to N random upgrades at once (N from the
# rl_chaos_draft game rule). Offered only once, at the start of a new game
# (see rl_game_start_action and the end of rl_monthly_action). Each pick
# rolls its own rarity -- the normal 65 / 27 / 8 odds for x1 / x2 / x5 -- and
# is applied straight away by the generated rl_rand_grant: no offers, no
# curses, no artifacts. Synergy sets and threat count every pick as usual.
#
# rl_rarity is saved and restored, because an upgrade selection may still be
# waiting on screen and its options read var:rl_rarity when taken. The rarity
# roll is done here rather than with rl_roll_rarity, which would also spend a
# Guaranteed Legendary bought in the token shop on the first pick.
rl_fun_mass_roll = {
    set_variable = { name = rl_fun_saved_rarity value = var:rl_rarity }
    if = { limit = { has_game_rule = rl_chaos_draft_500 } set_variable = { name = rl_fun_left value = 500 } }
    else_if = { limit = { has_game_rule = rl_chaos_draft_250 } set_variable = { name = rl_fun_left value = 250 } }
    else_if = { limit = { has_game_rule = rl_chaos_draft_50 } set_variable = { name = rl_fun_left value = 50 } }
    else = { set_variable = { name = rl_fun_left value = 100 } }
    set_variable = { name = rl_fun_n1 value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = rl_fun_n2 value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = rl_fun_n3 value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = rl_fun_total value = 0 }
    # rl_rand_grant sets this to 1 whenever it applies something; it stays 0
    # once every upgrade has been taken, which ends the loop early.
    set_variable = { name = rl_fun_hit value = 1 }

    while = {
        limit = {
            var:rl_fun_left > 0
            var:rl_fun_hit = 1
        }
        set_variable = { name = rl_fun_hit value = 0 }
        random_list = {
            65 = { set_variable = { name = rl_rarity value = 1 } }
            27 = { set_variable = { name = rl_rarity value = 2 } }
            8  = { set_variable = { name = rl_rarity value = 3 } }
        }
        rl_rand_grant = yes
        if = {
            limit = { var:rl_fun_hit = 1 }
            change_variable = { name = rl_fun_total add = 1 }
            if = { limit = { var:rl_rarity = 3 } change_variable = { name = rl_fun_n3 add = 1 } }
            else_if = { limit = { var:rl_rarity = 2 } change_variable = { name = rl_fun_n2 add = 1 } }
            else = { change_variable = { name = rl_fun_n1 add = 1 } }
        }
        change_variable = { name = rl_fun_left add = -1 }
    }

    set_variable = { name = rl_rarity value = var:rl_fun_saved_rarity }
}

# --- Upgrade history --------------------------------------------------------

# rl_record_take: remember that upgrade $n$ was TAKEN, and at what multiplier,
# for the Upgrade History pages (rl_history.1-4). Called by every take option
# and by the Chaos Draft. Banishing also sets var_<name>, so var_<name> alone
# cannot tell owned upgrades apart from banished ones.
rl_record_take = {
    if = { limit = { var:rl_rarity = 3 } set_variable = { name = rl_got_$n$ value = 5 } }
    else_if = { limit = { var:rl_rarity = 2 } set_variable = { name = rl_got_$n$ value = 2 } }
    else = { set_variable = { name = rl_got_$n$ value = 1 } }
}

# --- Notoriety consequences -------------------------------------------------

# rl_notoriety_backlash: run by rl_status.9's immediate, for a country whose
# notoriety reached tier 3+ (20+ upgrades). Every neighbour and every great
# power grows antagonistic toward it; at tier 5 (55+ upgrades) one great power
# -- or failing that a neighbour -- also gets a Cut Down to Size casus belli
# against it for 10 years, saved as scope:rl_backlash_cb for the event text.
# Allies, subjects and the overlord are spared.
rl_notoriety_backlash = {
    every_country = {
        limit = {
            NOT = { this = root }
            OR = {
                is_neighbor_of = root
                is_great_power = yes
            }
            rl_backlash_eligible = yes
        }
        if = {
            limit = { root = { var:rl_threat >= 55 } }
            add_antagonism = { target = root modifier = rl_antagonism_notoriety_3 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { root = { var:rl_threat >= 35 } }
            add_antagonism = { target = root modifier = rl_antagonism_notoriety_2 }
        }
        else = {
            add_antagonism = { target = root modifier = rl_antagonism_notoriety_1 }
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { var:rl_threat >= 55 }
        if = {
            limit = {
                any_country = {
                    is_great_power = yes
                    NOT = { this = root }
                    rl_backlash_eligible = yes
                }
            }
            random_country = {
                limit = {
                    is_great_power = yes
                    NOT = { this = root }
                    rl_backlash_eligible = yes
                }
                save_scope_as = rl_backlash_cb
            }
        }
        else = {
            random_neighbor_country = {
                limit = { rl_backlash_eligible = yes }
                save_scope_as = rl_backlash_cb
            }
        }
        scope:rl_backlash_cb ?= {
            add_casus_belli = {
                target = root
                type = casus_belli:cb_cut_down_in_size
                years = 10
            }
        }
    }
}

# --- Starting boons ---------------------------------------------------------

# rl_boon_rand: a random boon id (1-7) into rl_boon_offer_$v$.
rl_boon_rand = {
    random_list = {
        1 = { set_variable = { name = rl_boon_offer_$v$ value = 1 } }
        1 = { set_variable = { name = rl_boon_offer_$v$ value = 2 } }
        1 = { set_variable = { name = rl_boon_offer_$v$ value = 3 } }
        1 = { set_variable = { name = rl_boon_offer_$v$ value = 4 } }
        1 = { set_variable = { name = rl_boon_offer_$v$ value = 5 } }
        1 = { set_variable = { name = rl_boon_offer_$v$ value = 6 } }
        1 = { set_variable = { name = rl_boon_offer_$v$ value = 7 } }
    }
}

# rl_pick_three_boons: three DISTINCT boons into rl_boon_offer_1/2/3. There
# are 7, so the distinctness loops always terminate.
rl_pick_three_boons = {
    rl_boon_rand = { v = 1 }
    rl_boon_rand = { v = 2 }
    while = {
        limit = { var:rl_boon_offer_2 = var:rl_boon_offer_1 }
        rl_boon_rand = { v = 2 }
    }
    rl_boon_rand = { v = 3 }
    while = {
        limit = {
            OR = {
                var:rl_boon_offer_3 = var:rl_boon_offer_1
                var:rl_boon_offer_3 = var:rl_boon_offer_2
            }
        }
        rl_boon_rand = { v = 3 }
    }
}

# rl_take_boon: adopt boon $n$ for the rest of the run. var:rl_boon is what the
# hooks in rl_roll_rarity, rl_roll_curse, rl_apply_threat,
# rl_grant_reroll_token and rl_take_<tag> check.
rl_take_boon = {
    set_variable = { name = rl_boon value = $n$ }
    add_country_modifier = { modifier = modifier_rl_boon_$n$ years = -1 }
    if = {
        limit = { var:rl_boon = 6 }
        set_variable = { name = rl_reroll_tokens value = 0 }
    }
}
